question: What is the meaning of material composition in relation to material health?
description: Material composition refers to the constituent parts and materials that make up a product. In relation to material health, understanding the composition of materials is crucial for identifying potentially hazardous substances and ensuring compliance with health and safety regulations. This knowledge helps in selecting materials that are safe for indoor air quality, employee satisfaction, and overall building health. Additionally, it aids in the optimization of dismantling and recycling processes, contributing to a circular economy and sustainable construction practices.

3.1.3
Composition properties
Figure 5 shows the composition property facet. This block of ontology helps to optimise
the selection, processing, and assembly of the constituent parts and materials of a product
and facilitates their separation, dismantling, and recycling at the end of life of a product
to maximise the circularity.
Figure 5: Composition property facet of the MPO.
CompositionProperty has two subclasses, ConstituentPart and ConstituentMaterial. For
example, crossbeam has constituent materials carbon fibre, glass fibre, epoxy resin, alu-
minium, foam, and film adhesive that have mass, and a source and destination in a circular
economy.
